# SCH-W8300 QPST handset probe

This is the first physical-device experiment for the owner-reported Samsung SCH-W8300. It is intentionally small and uses only static storage plus eleven graphics/timer calls present in the confirmed SCH-W830 DL21 fixed-root subset. That sibling-device ABI is a candidate for SCH-W8300, not confirmed evidence.
